purpose: Teach: 国名/軽自動車/預ける/最大手/料率/概論/役務/全日空

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、国名表記を正確に行政書類で統一されますね
lines.en: So the police do make sure country names are recorded consistently across official documents.
lines.style: Curious, respectful. Soft question-inflection at the end. Leaning slightly forward, genuinely interested in confirmation. Even pace, warm but careful not to presume.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、軽自動車のひき逃げ事案も捜査されますね
lines.en: And the police investigate hit-and-run cases involving light vehicles too, don't they.
lines.style: Following thread naturally. Slightly more comfortable now. Steady pace, eye contact held. A statement that asks for confirmation without demanding it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、市民が貴重品を預ける場合の指導もされますね
lines.en: You also advise citizens on how to safely deposit valuables, I imagine.
lines.style: Building understanding gently. Observant tone — noticing the breadth of what they do. Breath steady, rhythm unhurried. Warm acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、業界最大手の防犯協会と連携されますね
lines.en: And you coordinate with the major crime-prevention associations in the industry, right.
lines.style: Piecing together picture thoughtfully. Slight pause before speaking — respect for the scope of work. Measured cadence. Tone of genuine discovery, not interrogation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、不正料率で違法保険販売した事案を捜査されますね
lines.en: You also investigate cases of illegal insurance sales conducted at improper rates.
lines.style: Deeper understanding settling in. More direct now, but not accusatory. Statement delivered with quiet certainty. Slight emphasis on the word 'illegal' without judgment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、新人向け法概論の研修もなさるんですね
lines.en: Even conducting legal overview training programs for new officers, I gather.
lines.style: Admiration creeping in subtly. Lighter breath, almost impressed. Pace picks up slightly — recognition of comprehensive responsibility. Warm, genuine.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、行政役務委託の検証も担当されますね
lines.en: And verifying contracted administrative services as well.
lines.style: Still finding new dimensions. Eyes bright with respect. Conversational pace. Slight wonder that one organization manages so much. Sincere.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、全日空のVIP警備も担当ですね
lines.en: Including VIP security for All Nippon Airways, if I'm not mistaken.
lines.style: Close now — familiarity and ease. Slight smile in the voice. Knowing nod quality. Pace relaxed, intimate. Affection underneath the observation.
